description: This file contains the implementation of the MediaPipelineTestBase class, which provides a base for unit testing media pipeline components. It includes mock setup, media pipeline creation and destruction, and methods to simulate media source attachment, EOS handling, and data notification within a media pipeline testing context.

classes.name: MediaPipelineTestBase
classes.description: A base class providing common setup, teardown, and utility methods for media pipeline unit tests.

methods.name: createMediaPipeline
methods.description: Initializes the media pipeline with mocked dependencies and sets up the main thread environment.

methods.name: destroyMediaPipeline
methods.description: Cleans up and resets the media pipeline, unmapping resources and unregistering clients.

methods.name: mainThreadWillEnqueueTask
methods.description: Sets expectation for enqueuing a task on the main thread.

methods.name: mainThreadWillEnqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Sets expectation for enqueuing a task on the main thread and waiting for its completion.

methods.name: loadGstPlayer
methods.description: Loads a mock GStreamer player and triggers network buffering notification.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source (audio or video) to the media pipeline and returns its ID.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Simulates end-of-stream for a given media source type, triggering related callbacks.

methods.name: expectNotifyNeedData
methods.description: Sets expectations for notifying the media pipeline client about needed media data.

methods.name: expectNotifyNeedDataEos
methods.description: Sets expectations for notifying the media pipeline client about EOS condition for a source.
